name: Savannah River
summary: Cowan, Reines and collaborators directly detected reactor electron antineutrinos at Savannah River in the 1950s. The delayed-coincidence method provided the decisive experimental confirmation of the free neutrino.
detection_principle: Antineutrinos undergo inverse beta decay in a water target containing cadmium. The prompt positron annihilation produces gamma rays, followed by delayed neutron-capture gamma rays. Scintillator layers detect the characteristic time-correlated light signals.
